summary.quick_take: Webflow and Dorik both sit in the broader website builder landscape, but they appeal to slightly different buying motions. Webflow leans into recurring payouts, while Dorik leans into recurring lifetime payouts. The better fit depends on whether you want the cleaner affiliate story, the broader positioning angle, or both.
